seed: Prefer the simplest stateless rule set. Treat every object type that never changes in the data as static scenery and model only the types that change.

synth.notes:
Blocks (colour-10 4x4) move as a pair: A1/A2 vertical by 4, A3 apart / A4 together, mirrored by side.
Click inactive marker 9 arms it (marker becomes active 11, blocks become players 1); clicking a player disarms.
While armed, A1-A4 move the active marker cell by 4. A move succeeds iff the destination 4x4 is all floor 5 inside rows 1-62.
HUD: zeros in row 0 from the right and row 63 from the left, width (128a+150)//300, a = actions this level (hidden, continuity-gated).
Unconfirmed: what triggers a level reset; unchanged types (walls, hazards) treated as static scenery read from the frame.
